# Pitch Interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PitchInterval`](gmeow-PitchInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchInterval>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A frame-relative directed interval between two pitch values, expressed as an exact ratio or in cents. Intervals are not subclasses of [`PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md); they are a distinct kind of frame-relative quantity ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](gmeow-PitchExpression.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PitchInterval`](gmeow-PitchInterval.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:PitchExpression`](gmeow-PitchExpression.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
